{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
data['biomarker_final'] = data['biomarker_final'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute the response rate by sex
crosstab = pd.crosstab(data['sex'], data['responded'], normalize='index') * 100
crosstab = crosstab.round(2)

crosstab"}
